استمسكت (form X)
# اِسْتَمْسَكْتُ (istamsaktu) /is.tam.sak.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَمْسَكَ (istamsaka)
# اِسْتَمْسَكْتَ (istamsakta) /is.tam.sak.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَمْسَكَ (istamsaka)
# اِسْتَمْسَكْتِ (istamsakti) /is.tam.sak.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَمْسَكَ (istamsaka)
# اِسْتَمْسَكَتْ (istamsakat) /is.t
